  "outcome_measure": "Subjective experience of ambivalence measured using a 6-point scale across a list of 30 unrelated objects",
  "population_and_setting": "Introductory psychology students participating in exchange for partial course requirement credit, completing study materials via an e-mailed computer program",

  "recruitment_and_incentive": "Students enrolled in an introductory psychology course who signed up and received study materials via e-mail in partial fulfillment of a course requirement",
  "analysis_plan": "One-way analysis of variance (ANOVA) comparing participants' mean ambivalence scores across the three mind-set conditions, followed by specific pairwise comparisons",
  "preregistered_or_confirmatory": "not stated",
  "other_methods_notes": "Objects semantically related to participants' personal problems or projects were removed prior to analysis to control for semantic priming effects."
